seo.title: Contact Atlaxys — Start a software project
seo.description: Tell us about your project. Reach Atlaxys Consulting by form, email or WhatsApp for software engineering, AI automation, DevOps and technology consulting.

hero.title: Tell us what you are building.
hero.lead: A few details help us come back with useful questions — and, when it makes sense, a first estimate. Prefer a conversation? WhatsApp and email work just as well.

channels.title: Direct lines
channels.whatsappText: For quick questions and scheduling a call.

next.title: What happens next
steps: We read your message and reply, usually within one working day, often with a few clarifying questions.
A 30-minute call to understand the problem, the constraints and the timeline. No preparation needed.
A written proposal: approach, phases, estimate ranges and the assumptions behind them.

thankYou.title: Thank you — we have your message.
thankYou.text: An engineer from our team will reply by email, usually within one working day. If it is urgent, WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us.
